references.text: The same warning structure concerning disobedience to the Lord's commands and the ensuing curses that will strike the people
Presents the choice between blessing and curse based on obedience to God's commands
A contrasting parallel describing the blessings of obedience, while verse 15 introduces the curses of disobedience
Repeats the warning of destruction if the people turn away and do not obey the Lord's voice
Joshua reminds the people that curses will come if they break the covenant, in line with Moses' warning
Daniel confesses that Israel did not obey the Lord's voice, and that the curses written in the Law of Moses were poured out on them
The prophet accuses the people of not obeying the Lord's voice and keeping His commands
An exhortation to turn from evil ways, referencing the prophets' warnings that the ancestors did not heed
Paul quotes Scripture saying that a curse rests on those who do not keep everything written in the Book of the Law
